The '''Datch family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family living in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] was a member of the family. Tarrin's parents owned [[Pellezara station]], and in addition to servicing large [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], the family put on flight shows for their customers.
